relevance_scale.0: not relevant (implicit for every unlisted passage)

manifest.annotation_policy: Judgment IDs use the corpus v1 one-chunk reference form document_id:0. The evaluator maps these to source passages, collapses multiple retrieved chunks to their source document, and ranks each passage once so alternate chunk-size sweeps remain comparable. Unlisted documents have grade 0. Queries and judgments are synthetic and intended to validate the evaluation pipeline, not support claims about production retrieval.
limitations: One query per narrow test intent/domain pair gives no statistical power.
Judgments are authored with the synthetic corpus and may favor its vocabulary.
No model was run to create these relevance labels.
All passages are fictional fixtures written for evaluation tooling.
No supplier availability, real policies, prices, or legal terms are represented.
Passages fit in one chunk under the declared chunking reference; retrieval metrics collapse any alternate chunks back to their source passage.
